subject: Re: GCP private offer — smoothing consumption velocity and phasing options
messages:
From: Aisha Nayar <procure@stratusworks.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
Cc: 
Date: Sun, 20 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: GCP private offer — smoothing for Q3/Q4 consumption

Hi Markus,

We reviewed the private offer you sent last week and we need to propose a slightly different redemption cadence to match our fiscal quarter planning. Our platform has a big launch targeted for mid-Q3 and then steady ingestion through Q4; we'd like to avoid a sharp cliff in month 1 and instead smooth usage over 6 months.

Can Redwood provide an example phased drawdown schedule (monthly token buckets) and confirm whether any price breaks apply if we reprofile the consumption to be more even across months? Also, we need an example invoice schedule and any required PO wording for GCP Marketplace private offer redemption.

Attaching our high-level expected run-rate and a preliminary PO timeline.

Attachments: po-timeline-stratusworks.pdf (pdf), expected-run-rate.csv (csv)

Thanks,
Aisha Nayar
Procurement Lead, StratusWorks
procure@stratusworks.com

From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
To: Aisha Nayar <procure@stratusworks.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: GCP private offer — smoothing for Q3/Q4 consumption

Hi Aisha — thank you for the details and the timeline. We can absolutely support a smoothing profile. Quick summary below so we're aligned before Ben/Marissa and I pull together the formal schedule: 

- Option A (phased smoothing): equal token buckets across 6 months, with a soft ramp in month 1 at 15% of offer, then 17% months 2–6 to even out.
- Option B (ramp + reserve): higher initial month (25%) then smoothing months 2–5 at 18% and residual 1% credit buffer in month 6 for burst protection.
- Pricing: standard private-offer unit price would remain the same for Option A. For Option B we can offer a temporary usage credit (one-time) of up to 8% of month-1 consumption to help with the initial ramp (requires commit confirmation in the PO).

I attached a spreadsheet with both schedules and the suggested invoice triggers (monthly redemption, invoice issued on the 5th of following month). If that works, Ben can produce the PO wording we recommend and Marissa will flag any marketplace seller ops steps.

Attachments: private-offer-velocity.xlsx (spreadsheet)

Markus Klein
Head of Strategic Partnerships, Redwood Inference
markus_klein@redwood.com

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 22 Jun 2027 09:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: GCP private offer — smoothing for Q3/Q4 consumption

Looping in operational details here — we should be explicit about the Marketplace redemption window and billing waterfall so Procurement doesn't hit surprises: 

- Redemptions are processed at the SKU level monthly; if StratusWorks redeems equal monthly buckets we'll mark them as "scheduled redemptions" and GCP will invoice per month.
- To enable the 8% credit (Option B) we need a line in the PO: "Redwood to apply one-time ramp credit of X USD conditional on signed commit and 6-month redemption schedule." Legal will want the credit capped and non-cumulative.
- Suggest we include an acceptance clause for early overage: "Any consumption above the scheduled monthly redemption will be billed at the standard unit rate and reconciled monthly."

I also recommend the following ops checklist before finalizing:
- Confirm the exact SKUs to map to StratusWorks environments.
- Share GCP account IDs to bind the private offer.
- Upload the signed PO and trigger the seller-side redemption mapping.

If we want to be conservative, propose Option A with a small 3% launch credit rather than the full 8% — easier to approve on the seller-side. Thoughts?

Ben Carter
Senior Sales Manager, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com
